Design a modern, mobile-friendly PTA website for an elementary school called “Cox Elementary PTA” with an eagle mascot theme 🦅.

The website should feel:

warm,

organized,

trustworthy,

community-centered,

visually polished,

and modern like a nonprofit/community startup rather than an outdated school website.

The design aesthetic should combine:

modern nonprofit website,

Canva-inspired layouts,

clean elementary school branding,

subtle school spirit,

and soft corporate professionalism.

Avoid:

clutter,

tiny text,

outdated school website aesthetics,

excessive primary colors,

overwhelming navigation,

and walls of text.



Branding & Visual Direction

Color Palette:

Primary Navy: #1F3A5F

Accent Gold: #E3B341

Soft Blue: #DCE8F5

White backgrounds

Light gray sections for separation

Typography:

Headings: Poppins or Montserrat

Body text: Inter or Open Sans

Visual style:

rounded cards,

soft shadows,

layered sections,

modern spacing,

large clickable buttons,

clean iconography,

subtle eagle watermark graphics in the background,

light star/sparkle accents used minimally.

The website should feel polished and premium while still approachable for families.



Website Structure

Top navigation:

Home

Events

Volunteer

PTA Membership

Fundraising

Newsletter

Resources

About PTA

Contact

Sticky navigation on scroll.

Mobile-responsive hamburger menu.



Homepage Layout

HERO SECTION

Create a large welcoming hero section with:

smiling elementary school families/students,

eagle mascot branding,

welcoming headline,

supportive PTA messaging,

large CTA buttons.

Headline example:
“Building Community, Supporting Students, Strengthening Our School”

Buttons:

Join PTA

Volunteer

View Events

Donate

Add subtle animated shapes or floating accents for a modern feel.



QUICK LINKS SECTION

Create large rounded quick-access cards for:

Calendar

Lunch Menu

Volunteer Signups

Spirit Wear

Newsletter

Attendance Reporting

Cards should use icons and be highly mobile-friendly.



UPCOMING EVENTS SECTION

Modern card-based event layout featuring:

Book Fair

Family STEM Night

Spirit Day

PTA Meeting

Teacher Appreciation Week

Each card should include:

date,

short description,

CTA button,

flyer thumbnail preview.

Use layered card designs with clean spacing.



NEWSLETTER / FLYER HUB

Create a visual bulletin-board-inspired section showing:

flyers,

announcements,

weekly newsletters,

fundraiser graphics.

This section should feel dynamic and highly visual.

Use Pinterest-style grid layouts or modern masonry layouts.



VOLUNTEER SPOTLIGHT SECTION

Feature volunteer opportunities using warm community-centered design.

Include:

parent spotlight cards,

volunteer signup buttons,

committee highlights,

encouraging messaging.



FUNDRAISING SECTION

Create a polished fundraiser progress section with:

donation thermometer/progress bar,

explanation of how funds help students,

sponsor highlights,

spirit wear promo area.

Make this section feel motivating and transparent.



STUDENT SPOTLIGHT SECTION

Feature:

student artwork,

achievements,

reading milestones,

classroom highlights.

Create a celebratory and uplifting tone.



FOOTER

Include:

PTA contact info,

school address,

social media icons,

quick links,

copyright,

newsletter signup form.

Use a dark navy footer with elegant spacing.



Functionality & UX

The site should:

feel fast and modern,

prioritize mobile responsiveness,

use large tap targets for parents on phones,

have excellent visual hierarchy,

feel extremely easy to navigate.

Parents should immediately understand:

what’s happening,

how to volunteer,

where resources are,

and how to participate.



Design Inspiration

Blend inspiration from:

modern nonprofit websites,

Apple-style spacing,

Canva aesthetics,

school communication platforms,

community organization branding,

and clean startup landing pages.

The final design should feel:

premium,

community-centered,

highly visual,

easy to update,

and emotionally welcoming.

Use realistic placeholder content and realistic PTA event examples throughout the mockup.
